summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) end-to-end: implement API backend, owner UI, and recipient write actions for IPFS-based shared folders, verify the feature through UAT, and ship with security review and E2E test coverage.
summary.outcome: Phase 27 fully shipped: 3 plans executed, 12 security issues fixed (TDD), 21 E2E tests written and passing, PR #372 created with all review comments resolved. Multiple critical crypto bugs discovered and fixed during UAT including broken IPNS record creation for shared uploads and dual-key wrapping for owner+recipient access.

repo: Shared uploads in useSharedNavigation.ts originally set fileMetaIpnsName: '' (line 807), meaning files uploaded through shared folders had no retrievable IPNS record — a fundamental PoC gap requiring full IPNS keypair inlining

The repo has two conflicting RequestWithUser types: one in common/types.ts (extends Express Request) and a local one in auth.controller.ts (extends NestJS @nestjs/common Request) — the local one was incorrect and caused pre-existing spec errors
TextEditorDialog.tsx save path used the owner's useFolder hook for all saves, including shared files — shared files require a completely separate save path through useSharedNavigation
Owner's handleUpdateFile in useFileOperations.ts did not re-wrap file keys for share recipients after edits — recipients would lose access after owner edits (pre-existing gap, not phase 27 specific)
The NestJS API has a Swagger/OpenAPI JSON endpoint but @ApiProperty enum decorators must be updated alongside DTO IsIn validators for the generated spec to reflect new enum values
web-e2e tests use inline inputs for shared mkdir (.shared-inline-input-field) rather than the CreateFolderDialog modal used by the owner's file browser
The addShareKeys endpoint allows file-ipns as a key type for storing recipient-wrapped IPNS private keys separately from file content keys
cipher-box-ci-debug is a separate checkout that does not share .env files with the main cipher-box repo — env files must be explicitly copied between checkouts
The API uses TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) for IPNS key operations — IPNS private keys must be encrypted with the TEE public key before transmission, never stored plaintext

code.finding: Original shared upload set fileMetaIpnsName: '' — fixed by inlining full IPNS keypair generation (generateFileIpnsKeypair, createIpnsRecord, marshalIpnsRecord) instead of calling createFileMetadata()
withConflictRetry closures captured stale React state for currentSequenceNumber and folderChildren — fixed by adding refs (folderChildrenRef, sequenceNumberRef) synced alongside state updates
IPNS/folder keys were zeroed only on happy path — moved to finally block so keys are always zeroed even on failure
Shared file save threw 'Parent folder not found' because it used the owner's updateFile hook — fixed by adding onSaveSharedFile callback prop wired through SharedFileBrowser
handleUpdateFile did not call reWrapForRecipients after updating file content — recipients lost access after owner edits; fixed by adding reWrapForRecipients call post-update
IPNS publish authorization for write-share recipients did not require encryptedIpnsKey to be non-null, allowing auth bypass if field was cleared
Permission downgrade (write→read) was not wrapped in a transaction — share.save() and shareKey.delete() could partially fail leaving inconsistent state
keyType enum was 'file' | 'folder' only — extended to include 'file-ipns' for storing recipient-wrapped IPNS private keys; @ApiProperty enum must match IsIn validator for OpenAPI codegen
MinLength(2) on encryptedIpnsKey was too low — raised to MinLength(64) and added IsHexadecimal + even-length validation to match ECIES ciphertext format
FolderIpns create path had no guard against write-share recipients creating rows owned by themselves for another user's ipnsName — fixed with ForbiddenException if existing.userId !== userId

Navigation functions (navigateToSubfolder, navigateUp, navigateToBreadcrumb) did not sync folderChildrenRef/sequenceNumberRef — critical bug: any write operation immediately after navigation would use stale refs
Drag/drop handlers for read-only shares were missing e.preventDefault(), allowing browser default drop behavior on read-only shared folders
Row action buttons (upgrade/downgrade/revoke) each only checked their own pending state — a unified isBusy(shareId) check prevents concurrent actions on the same row

workflow: Background tasks started with run_in_background are killed when the conversation context shifts — use detached processes (nohup or &) for dev servers that must survive between turns
When OpenAPI spec doesn't reflect DTO changes, the API server's watch mode may not have picked up the change — a full restart is required, not just saving the file
TDD flow for security fixes: stash partial fixes, write failing tests first, pop stash, verify green — proves tests actually catch the bugs
Vite HMR picks up TypeScript changes to hooks and components automatically — no restart needed for most frontend changes, only for new env vars
pnpm api:generate (openapi-generator) reads from the live running API's /api-docs-json endpoint, so the API must be restarted with the latest code before regenerating the client
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded runtime bug in Claude Code fires after all tool calls complete and should be treated as success if spot-checks (SUMMARY.md, git commits) pass
Security reviews benefit from separating findings into E2E-testable (behavior) vs unit-testable (API logic) categories before writing tests
When fixing React stale closure bugs in hooks, refs must be synced in ALL state-setting locations including navigation functions, not just the primary data fetch path

friction: cipher-box-ci-debug had no .env files — required manually copying from the main cipher-box repo; the db host IP had also changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring .env creation from scratch before the correct copy
Background tasks (API/web dev servers) were killed repeatedly by conversation context shifts, requiring multiple restart cycles before switching to detached processes
Web app defaulted to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL was unset, silently connecting to wrong port (5173 instead of 3000) with no obvious error
SDK packages (core, sdk-core, sdk) needed to be built in dependency order before the web dev server would start — no clear error about which package was missing
OpenAPI codegen requires the API to be fully restarted (not just file-saved) to pick up DTO enum changes, causing a confusing cycle of regeneration attempts
git lock file conflict during commit mid-session required manual removal
The backend security review agent ran in parallel with manual fixes, creating a stash/pop dance to maintain TDD red→green ordering
E2E tests required 5 iterations to get all selectors correct (.share-recipient-permission → .recipient-perm-write, mkdir modal → .shared-inline-input-field, rename → .shared-inline-rename-field)
The VERIFICATION.md and tee-worker/package-lock.json were left uncommitted after the verifier agent completed — had to be caught and committed manually
Transaction-based downgrade broke the existing H-03 unit test because mocks targeted repo methods directly rather than the transaction manager
open_items: E2E tests for writable shares are written but not integrated into CI — they require two active wallet accounts and a running dev stack

reWrapForRecipients in useFileOperations.ts does not re-wrap file-ipns keys (IPNS private keys stored in share_keys) — only file content keys are re-wrapped when owner edits; noted in security review as L-03 but deferred as PoC scope
Polling in useSharedNavigation fetches all received shares on every tick (every 30s) rather than a targeted single-share endpoint — acceptable for PoC but will not scale
The shared upload flow creates IPNS records but does not handle the case where a recipient uploads to a nested subfolder (only top-level shared folder uploads are tested)
Silent revocation handling (403 → [RW] to [RO] transition with key zeroing) was implemented in the plan but the E2E test for it (test 5.3) was not run against the full revocation flow end-to-end
Pre-existing TypeScript error in device-approval.controller.spec.ts (mock RequestWithUser type) was not fixed — same root cause as the auth.controller.spec.ts issue that was fixed
Security review finding L-02 (BigInt sequence number coercion) was fixed in useSharedNavigation but the underlying API type may still return a string — should add an explicit API contract test
